_comment: Post-ingest mutations for the scaffy showcase (D18). Applied AFTER the two ingest payloads in this directory are POSTed to /v1/plugins/bulldocs/papers (admin bearer): the ingest whitelist does not pass the schema-native 'related' field, so the masterplan->showcase link is set via POST /v1/data/mutate/production with this body. Reproducibility: ingest scaffy-command-showcase.json, then scaffy-commands-as-content-repost.json, then this mutation batch.
